title: Sonochemically synthesized CuO-NPs: individual and synergistic toxicity assessment with sodium arsenite in adult zebrafish
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5795-5813
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09469K, Paper

Aqsa Huma, Ameer Hamza, Mazhar Iqbal Zafar, Muhammad Babar Taj, Zeshan Sheikh, Naveed Khan, Imtiaz Ahmad Khan, Ahmed Atiullah, Muhammad Majid
Individual and combined exposure to CuO-NPs and NaAsO2 induces oxidative stress-mediated histopathological and genotoxic damage in zebrafish, highlighting the ecological risks posed by emerging co-contaminants in aquatic systems.
